excluded_mentions.desc: Price rallying up into an aggressive supply zone and reacting/coming down off of that level ('if price comes up to supply, it very likely can react and come down off of that level').
excluded_mentions.why_mention: TP-placement rationale, not a taught standalone entry. The speaker invokes the supply-reaction only to justify where he sets the take-profit for the LONG three-step trade (target parked in the middle of the opposing supply). It is never taught as an independent fade-short setup: no bias step, no break/close confirmation, no retest trigger, and no stop rule of its own are given for entering short at supply. Per the example/rationale-not-a-rule guard it is a candidate mention, not a promotable strategy.
